title: How To Build A Life - from The Atlantic
description: Draw on the latest scientific research and the work of classic philosophers to help you lead a happier and more fulfilling life, with The Atlantic as your guide. Navigating the fine line of work-life balance, or contemplating a change of careers, or struggling to find meaning in your daily routine? You'll find thoughtful, science-backed wisdom in this notebook, based on The Atlantic's acclaimed 'How To Build A Life' column by Arthur Brooks, paired with ancient wisdom from the Greeks. Listen to an Audio Overview on the latest science on human happiness, or just use the chat to ask for advice on whatever life challenges you're facing.
author: Strotmic
